screen.tempestfx.title: Thunderhead Settings
option.tempestfx.preset.tooltip: Sets the particle budget and geometry detail. Everything below can still be changed on top of it.
option.tempestfx.reduced_flashing.toolti: Removes re-strikes and flicker and caps the exposure flash. Also honours Minecraft's own Hide Lightning Flashes option.
option.tempestfx.scale.tooltip: How far a bolt reaches into the sky.
option.tempestfx.return_strokes.tooltip: Extra flashes down the same channel, the way a real strike discharges more than once.
option.tempestfx.stepped_leader.tooltip: The channel builds downward in discrete steps and a bright return stroke then races back up it, instead of the whole bolt appearing at once.
option.tempestfx.distant_bolts.tooltip: The horizon full of forked channels during a rolling thunder event. The heaviest visual setting there is.
option.tempestfx.sky_activity.tooltip: Lightning between and inside the clouds, with no ground strike. What makes a distant storm look alive.
option.tempestfx.activity_rate.tooltip: How often the storm discharges into itself. Ambience only — it changes nothing about strikes that land.
option.tempestfx.cloud_to_cloud.tooltip: Horizontal channels travelling through the storm. Very rarely, one crosses the whole sky.
option.tempestfx.intracloud.tooltip: Discharges buried inside a cloud: almost no visible channel, several pulses of light from within.
option.tempestfx.cloud_illumination.tool: Clouds lighting up from the inside around a discharge.
option.tempestfx.superbolts.tooltip: Share of ground strikes drawn as a positive discharge: wider, far brighter, violet, and barely branched. Rare on purpose.
option.tempestfx.red_sprites.tooltip: Enormous red structures far above a storm, moments after a powerful positive discharge. Real, photographed for the first time in 1989, and gone in a fraction of a second.
option.tempestfx.blue_jets.tooltip: Cones of violet-blue light climbing out of a cloud top. Slower than a sprite — long enough to watch it rise.
option.tempestfx.streamers.tooltip: Lightning rods, metal and high ground reach up as the leader closes, and whichever connects first decides where the bolt lands.
option.tempestfx.air_distortion.tooltip: A screen-space heat-haze pass along the shock front. Applied by the mod's own composite pass, so it works with and without a shader pack.
option.tempestfx.entity_discharge.toolti: Arcs crawling over anything that was near a strike and is moving.
option.tempestfx.ash_imprint.tooltip: The branching scar burned into the ground by a direct hit on a player.
option.tempestfx.custom_thunder.tooltip: Replaces the two vanilla lightning sounds with Thunderhead's own layered thunder.
option.tempestfx.sound_delay.tooltip: Thunder arrives after the flash, at distance divided by 343 m/s.
option.tempestfx.giant_roll.tooltip: The long event: up to fifteen seconds of layered thunder with a storm front behind it.
option.tempestfx.render_distance.tooltip: How far away strikes are still drawn, in blocks.
option.tempestfx.lod.tooltip: Thins distant strikes. Turning this off is expensive during a busy storm.
option.tempestfx.suppress_vanilla_thunde: Silences Minecraft's own two lightning sounds. Turn it off if another mod relies on them.
